system.description:
An Unstable creature that moves more than 10 feet before the end of their next turn falls prone.

An Unstable creature suffers disadvantage on saving throws to resist being moved against its will or knocked Prone.

An Unstable creature reduces the damage they deal with melee attacks by 4.
system.summary: Falls Prone if it moves more than 10 ft before the end of its next turn; disadvantage against forced movement and Prone; −4 melee damage.

rules.text: Moving more than 10 ft before the end of its next turn knocks it Prone. Disadvantage on saves against being moved or knocked Prone. Its melee attacks deal 4 less damage.
